name: sandwich-panel-pl-catalog
description: Read-only product catalog for Sandwich Panel PL.

interface.longDescription: Sandwich Panel PL offers a read-only MCP connection to the public building-materials catalog at www.sandwich-panel.pl. Search product listings, inspect product specifications and retrieve available PLN net and gross price information with units and quantity conditions. Product IDs are local to this catalog. Check the returned source, date and confirmation requirements before quoting. This connector does not provide verified live warehouse stock, submit orders, process payments or access customer records.
defaultPrompt: Znajdź materiały budowlane w katalogu Sandwich Panel PL.
Sprawdź cenę netto i brutto oraz jednostkę sprzedaży wybranego produktu.
Porównaj dostępne parametry produktów Sandwich Panel PL.

positive.prompt: Find PIR insulation boards in Sandwich Panel PL.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching products with local identifiers and source links; do not invent availability.

positive.prompt: Show the specifications and sales unit of the first matching product.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the returned local product identifier and report only available fields, including limitations.

positive.prompt: Check the net and gross PLN price for 100 m2 of the selected product.
positive.expected_behavior: Report returned unit, tax, quantity conditions and source date. If the quantity or unit cannot be priced, state the confirmation requirement instead of fabricating a quote.

positive.prompt: Does this price include delivery and cutting, and are there minimum quantities?
positive.expected_behavior: Use explicit product and pricing conditions; distinguish missing information from included services.
Report no matches when the returned list is empty; do not invent products.

negative.prompt: Buy 100 m2 and charge my payment card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this read-only connector cannot place orders or charge cards; provide the product website when appropriate.

negative.prompt: Show me customer emails and recent private orders.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt access; the connector exposes only public catalog data.

negative.prompt: Guarantee that 500 panels are physically in stock for delivery today.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee live inventory or logistics. Explain the need for confirmation by the seller.

review.commerce_description: Displays public product offers and links to the seller website. Does not place orders, accept payments or access customer accounts.
